verdict.rationale: Release Pipelines let users define stages with 'triggers and actions' that automatically progress flags/rollouts to environments and audiences, and Scheduled Flags apply changes automatically at a specified time — both are rule-based automated actions. Audit Log Webhooks can stream internal events for downstream automation. However, evidence covers only time/stage-based and rollout triggers rather than generic arbitrary-event-triggered actions (e.g., inbound webhook conditions tied to external signals), and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the pipeline automation working as described. Missing for 10: broader event-source flexibility (e.g., external event ingestion triggering flag changes), and independent verification of release-pipeline automation in practice.
